content_fields.title: Validate the signature of all remote code/updates to verify their origin and integrity
content_fields.description: Verify a signature over any remote content before the service stores or serves it.
content_fields.finding: Remote content is fetched and stored with no signature or integrity check on its origin.
content_fields.current_code:
def _image_url_to_base64(image_url: str):
    response = requests.get(image_url, stream=True)
    encoded_image = base64.b64encode(response.content).decode()

    return encoded_image
criteria: Remote content is rejected when its signature does not verify.
The verification key is distributed out of band, not alongside the content.
Verification happens before the content is persisted.
